rationale: C103 flagged negative fair_value cells, but the raw schedule itself reports parenthesized negative fair values for unfunded revolver or delayed-draw positions. Examples include Hootsuite 1st Lien Revolver with cost (18,275) and fair value (10,666), Source Energy Services 1st Lien Delayed Draw Term Loan with cost (14,618) and fair value (9,411), and Accela 1st Lien Revolver with cost (14,059) and fair value (7,583). The stored negative values match the source presentation, so the negative-value check is too broad for these legitimate unfunded commitment rows.
